parts.text: In this experiment, you will investigate the image produced by a converging lens. Carry out the following instructions, referring to Fig. 3.1. Fig. 3.1

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) • Measure and record the height h o of the triangular object. h o = ..........................................................cm • Switch on the lamp. • Set the distance between the triangular object and the lens, u , to 30.0 cm. Move the screen until a clear focused image of the triangular object is seen. Measure, and record in Table 3.1, the height h I of the image. • Repeat the procedure for u values of 35.0 cm, 40.0 cm, 45.0 cm and 50.0 cm. • Switch off the lamp. Table 3.1 u / cm h I / cm N 30.0 35.0 40.0 45.0 50.0 [2]

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) For each distance u , calculate, and record in the table, a value N using your results from (a) and the equation N = h o h I . [1]

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) Plot a graph of u / cm ( y -axis) against N ( x -axis). You do not need to start your axes at the origin (0,0). [4]
